people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”
translations.bsb: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.”
translations.kjv: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
